newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BROK BREWER TO START BOURSE TRADE ON AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BROK BREWER TO START BOURSE TRADE ON AUG 14.

text.p: Polish brewery Brok SA BROK.CN will start trading on the Warsaw bourse's currently dormant free market, which trades in less liquid and small companies, on August 14, the bourse's deputy president said on Friday.
"The bourse's board decided to start trading Brok SA's stock on the free market on August 14," Wlodzimierz Magiera told a news conference.
The May's issue of the company's 287,500 shares of series C priced at 24 zlotys each was heavily over subscribed.
Magiera said the bourse would also start trading in the company's 1,150,000 shares of series A and 575,000 shares of series B.
Currently there are no firms listed on the free market.
